budgetRule.title: 50-30-20 Budget Rule
budgetRule.description: An educational budgeting guideline that divides monthly income into needs, wants, and savings.

categories.name: Needs
categories.description: Essential expenses such as food, transportation, education, and basic utilities.

categories.name: Wants
categories.description: Optional expenses such as entertainment, shopping, and other non-essential purchases.

categories.name: Savings
categories.description: Money set aside for savings goals and future needs.

validation.zero: Please enter an amount greater than zero.

budgetRule.educationalNote: The 50-30-20 split is an educational guideline, not a fixed rule. It may be adjusted according to an individual's circumstances and priorities.
